lines.en: Ana, I’m so annoyed. If I had read the reviews, I wouldn’t have bought this coffee machine.
lines.pt: Ana, estou tão irritada. Se eu tivesse lido as avaliações, não teria comprado esta cafeteira.

lines.en: What happened? If it had broken in the first week, you could have returned it for a refund.
lines.pt: O que aconteceu? Se ele tivesse quebrado na primeira semana, você poderia ter devolvido e pedido reembolso.

lines.en: It lasted two months. The reviews were full of complaints, but I only looked at the photos and the price.
lines.pt: Durou dois meses. As avaliações estavam cheias de reclamações, mas só olhei as fotos e o preço.

lines.en: That happens. If I hadn’t checked the stars last year, I would have ended up with a terrible laptop.
lines.pt: Acontece. Se eu não tivesse conferido as estrelas no ano passado, teria acabado com um notebook horrível.

lines.en: You were smart. If I had been more patient, I might have waited for the sale and saved a lot.
lines.pt: Você foi esperta. Se eu tivesse sido mais paciente, talvez tivesse esperado a liquidação e economizado muito.

lines.en: Did you contact the seller? If they had known about the fault, they would have replaced it.
lines.pt: Você falou com o vendedor? Se eles soubessem da falha, teriam trocado o produto.

lines.en: I did. They said the warranty had expired, so I would have had to pay for the repair myself.
lines.pt: Falei. Disseram que a garantia tinha expirado, então eu teria que pagar o conserto sozinha.

lines.en: That is unfair. If you had kept the packaging, we could have sent it back for free.
lines.pt: Isso é injusto. Se você tivesse guardado a embalagem, poderíamos tê-lo mandado de volta de graça.

lines.en: I threw it away. If I had known, I would have kept everything, believe me.
lines.pt: Eu joguei fora. Se eu soubesse, teria guardado tudo, acredite.

lines.en: Next time, read at least ten reviews, and look for honest ones with details, not just five stars.
lines.pt: Da próxima vez, leia pelo menos dez avaliações e procure as honestas, com detalhes, não só cinco estrelas.

lines.en: Deal. And if you hadn’t reminded me today, I would have bought another bargain I’d regret.
lines.pt: Combinado. E se você não tivesse me lembrado hoje, eu teria comprado outra pechincha da qual me arrependeria.

facts.big: if + had + particípio, would have + particípio
facts.label: Arrependimentos de compra
facts.sub: If I had read, I wouldn’t have bought it. You could have returned it. If I hadn’t checked, I would have ended up with a bad one.

facts.label: if + had + particípio
facts.sub: Use if + past perfect, would have + particípio para falar do passado que não aconteceu: If I had read the reviews, I wouldn’t have bought it. Em português: “se eu tivesse lido…”.

facts.label: would have + particípio
facts.sub: A oração do resultado usa would have + particípio. Pode usar could have (possibilidade) ou might have (talvez): You could have returned it. I might have saved money.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: If I had read is a past perfect clause.
We say “If I would have read”.
items.why: We say If I had read.

items.s: Would have bought is used in the result clause.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If I had read is a past perfect clause. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I would have read”. → Falso (We say If I had read.)
Would have bought is used in the result clause. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Reading reviews before buying · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot afternoon in Austin. Grace sits on the sofa with her phone. She is scrolling through product reviews. Ana comes in and sees her frown. Something she bought has stopped working. Grace sighs and starts to explain.

“Ana, I’m so annoyed. If I had read the reviews, I wouldn’t have bought this coffee machine.” says Grace. “What happened? If it had broken in the first week, you could have returned it for a refund.” says Ana. “It lasted two months. The reviews were full of complaints, but I only looked at the photos and the price.” says Grace.
